STR and Robust STR are new generic methods for time series decomposition; they allow for multiple seasonal, cyclic and linear components; seasonal patterns can be fractional and/or flexible; seasonal patterns can have a complex topology; they can be used to forecast; confidence intervals for the components are provided; and STR is related to Ridge Regression and LASSO.

STR and Robust STR are much more general and flexible than existing decomposition methods, and they can be used to decompose seasonal data into multiple seasonal components and multiple linear regressor effects, with fractional seasonal patterns (periodic, or with complex topologies) and with flexible seasonal patterns (over time).
